welcome.title: Welcome to Ontology Playground (Preview)
welcome.subtitle: Explore Microsoft Fabric IQ Ontology through the lens of Fourth Coffee
welcome.entityTypesText: Discover reusable logical models like Customer, Product, and Order
welcome.relationshipsText: See how entities connect with typed, directional links
welcome.dataBindingsText: Connect ontology concepts to real data platform sources
welcome.nlQueriesText: Ask questions in natural language and traverse the graph
welcome.footer: Complete quests to earn badges and learn about Microsoft Fabric IQ Ontology

tour.step1Desc: Use the toolbar to access the Catalogue, Designer, Learn articles, Import/Export, and more. Press ⌘K anytime to open the command palette.
tour.step2Desc: This is your ontology visualized as an interactive graph. Click on entity nodes or relationship edges to inspect them.
tour.step3Desc: Complete guided quests to learn ontology concepts step by step. Earn badges and points along the way!
tour.step4Desc: Select an entity to see its properties and data bindings. Use the query bar at the bottom to ask natural language questions.
tour.step5Desc: Build your own ontologies from scratch or start from a template. Export as RDF or submit to the community catalogue.

inspector.title: Inspector
inspector.selectHint: Click on an entity type or relationship in the graph to inspect its properties, data bindings, and connections.
